name: Testnizer Offline API Testing
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed offline desktop API testing client for HTTP/REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SSE and MCP, with local SQLite collections and test suites; no vendor-enforced request, seat or time quota for the locally run software.
watch_out: Runs on the user's Windows, macOS or Linux computer; not a hosted API testing service. Network API providers, AI model APIs and external services may impose separate fees or quotas. Beta binaries may show OS signing warnings; verify downloads and do not assume production security certification.
